question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing left back, and Claire is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) left back
(C) left midfielder
solution:
Positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire
Initial: center midfielder | left back | left midfielder
1. Claire–Bob: center midfielder | left midfielder | left back
2. Bob–Claire: center midfielder | left back | left midfielder
3. Claire–Alice: left midfielder | left back | center midfielder
Bob plays left back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
